description: Mediation Board Commission - Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointments of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the appointment of judicial/legal officers (mediators and chairmen for Mediation Boards) by the Mediation Boards Commission under the Mediation Boards Act. It involves law enforcement and judicial administration matters, specifically calling for nominations to fill judicial positions in various districts, which falls under the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9).
